llm_response.reason: The website impersonates the official WWE Shop, using the WWE brand, wrestler names, and official-sounding product listings. There is no verifiable company information, licensing display, or business address—only vague contact details and generic trust claims. These are hallmarks of a fake online shop exploiting a popular brand, likely to defraud buyers. The characteristics present (brand spoofing, lack of business transparency, typical scam trust signals, and an implausibly comprehensive stock of licensed goods) match several key scam website indicators.
